bad_examples.name: warn-header-in-neutral-field
bad_examples.content:
declare const req: any; declare const logger: any;
logger.warn({ detail: req.headers.authorization }, 'authentication failed');

bad_examples.name: error-bracket-header
bad_examples.content:
declare const req: any;
console.error('authentication failed', req.headers['authorization']);

bad_examples.name: uppercase-authorization-header
bad_examples.content:
declare const req: any; declare const logger: any;
logger.error({ detail: req.headers['AUTHORIZATION'] }, 'upstream rejected request');

bad_examples.name: mixed-case-headers-get
bad_examples.content:
declare const req: any;
console.warn('request credentials', req.headers.get('aUtHoRiZaTiOn'));

bad_examples.name: nested-console-access-token
bad_examples.content:
declare const session: any;
console.info({ diagnostic: { credential: session.accessToken } });

bad_examples.name: api-key-bracket-in-neutral-field
bad_examples.content:
declare const req: any; declare const logger: any;
logger.info({ detail: req.headers['x-api-key'] }, 'request received');

bad_examples.name: uppercase-api-key-object
bad_examples.content:
declare const credentials: any;
console.log({ payload: credentials.API_KEY });

bad_examples.name: snake-case-token-object
bad_examples.content:
declare const session: any;
console.debug({ diagnostics: { access_token: session.access_token } });

good_examples.name: actor-and-request-id-only
good_examples.content:
declare const user: any; declare const req: any; declare const logger: any;
logger.info({ actor_id: user.id, request_id: req.id }, 'authentication succeeded');

good_examples.name: safe-authorization-decision-flag
good_examples.content:
declare const allowed: boolean; declare const logger: any;
logger.info({ authorization_granted: allowed }, 'permission decision');

good_examples.name: ordinary-status-and-error-code
good_examples.content:
declare const response: any;
console.error({ status: response.status, code: 'AUTH_FAILED' }, 'request rejected');
